basics.name: Joe Pegler
basics.label: Staff-level Infrastructure Engineer
basics.specialties: Blockchain Execution · SDKs · Smart Accounts · Cross-Chain Systems
basics.summary: Senior infrastructure engineer building production blockchain transaction and execution systems across EVM and Solana. My work spans backend architecture, typed SDKs, smart-account and cross-chain workflows, with deep ERC-4337 expertise and a focus on simulation, observability, reliability, and developer experience. Experienced owning architecture and implementation in small, senior teams.

selectedImpact: Designed and operated internal ERC-4337 transaction orchestration and bundler infrastructure at defi.app, powering $100M+ daily trading volume with ~95% swap success and 20–40% faster execution than ZeroDev.
Built @biconomy/abstractjs from scratch as a viem-inspired TypeScript SDK for smart accounts and multi-chain execution; grew it to ~5.2k weekly npm downloads.

Unified cross-chain execution and routing across LiFi, Jupiter, 1inch, Odos, Mayan, LayerZero, and Relay, with EVM and Solana simulation, sponsorship, and transaction-safety infrastructure behind typed SDK surfaces shared by frontend and backend teams.

work.summary: Owned backend and SDK architecture for production transaction execution across EVM and Solana, from route selection and simulation through sponsorship and submission.
highlights: Designed and operated an internal ERC-4337 bundler coordinating wallet pools, nonces, fees, sponsorship policy, simulation, and submission; powered $100M+ daily volume (~5k–7k swaps/day) at ~95% success and 20–40% faster execution than ZeroDev.

Engineered the reliability layer around EntryPoint v7 simulation, guarded retries and fallbacks, ABI/Sourcify-backed error decoding, and structured operational errors for product and production debugging.
Built EVM and Solana simulation and sponsorship infrastructure, including Jito-aware safety validation, while diagnosing nonce contention, RPC lag, slippage, and simulation-to-execution mismatches.
Unified LiFi, Jupiter, 1inch, Odos, Mayan, LayerZero, and Relay behind typed routing and execution APIs, including RouteClient and ExecutionManager surfaces used across frontend and backend teams.

work.summary: Owned architecture and implementation of @biconomy/abstractjs, Biconomy's TypeScript developer platform for ERC-4337 smart accounts and multi-chain execution.
highlights: Built the SDK from scratch around viem-inspired abstractions, modular clients, typed APIs, composable batching, and account-agnostic execution flows.
Grew the package to approximately 5.2k weekly npm downloads and wrote the documentation and examples used by product teams integrating gasless and smart-account journeys.
Implemented Safe, EIP-712, EIP-1271, ERC-6492, P-256, and passkey compatibility, with production safeguards backed by Vitest, Bun, GitHub Actions, and Codecov.

work.summary: Owned application architecture and production delivery for Enso's primary Ethereum dApp, connecting DeFi execution workflows to protocol, API, and indexing systems.
highlights: Led the application from early product stages through production, defining integration boundaries and API contracts with protocol and backend engineers for transaction and execution workflows.
Built Graph Protocol indexing and intent/routing-adjacent product surfaces, with ownership of execution UX, operational quality, and release delivery.

work.summary: Led engineering delivery for a live trading product, owning interface architecture, team standards, core feature rollout, and release infrastructure.
highlights: Automated CI/CD for the interface stack, improving deployment consistency and reducing release risk in a production trading environment.

earlierExperience: GameAnalytics · Lead Frontend Developer (2016 to 2019): led a team of five, defined architecture and quality standards, and received the company MVP award for 2018/19.
FSI, Healthcare 21, and Nixatel (2013 to 2016): delivered enterprise, mobile, and web products in small engineering teams.
